name: Standard US GAAP & IRS Business Chart of Accounts

accounts.name: Software/SaaS
accounts.description: Cloud hosting, developer tools, subscriptions, SaaS products (AWS, GitHub, Slack, Notion, OpenAI)

accounts.name: Meals & Entertainment
accounts.description: Business client dining, coffee meetings, staff meals, food delivery (Blue Bottle, Starbucks, Uber Eats)

accounts.name: Office Supplies
accounts.description: Stationery, desk accessories, minor consumables, printer paper (Amazon, Staples, Target)

accounts.name: Travel
accounts.description: Flights, hotels, lodging, train tickets, rental cars (United Airlines, Airbnb, Marriott, Delta)

accounts.name: Transportation & Rideshare
accounts.description: Local transit, taxis, rideshares, parking, tolls (Uber, Lyft, Fastrak, Lime)

accounts.name: Advertising & Marketing
accounts.description: Digital ads, sponsor packages, campaigns, promotional media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Twitter Ads)

accounts.name: Professional Fees
accounts.description: Legal counsel, accounting services, tax prep, audit consultants (Gusto, Carta, Cooley, Stripe Legal)

accounts.name: Hardware & Equipment
accounts.description: Laptops, monitors, smartphones, server hardware (Apple Store, Best Buy, Dell)

accounts.name: Utilities & Telecommunications
accounts.description: Internet service, phone bills, cellular data, office electricity (AT&T, Verizon, Comcast, PG&E)

accounts.name: Dues & Subscriptions
accounts.description: Professional memberships, trade association fees, business certifications

accounts.name: Bank & Merchant Fees
accounts.description: Wire transfer charges, card processing fees, foreign transaction charges (Stripe Fees, Chase Wire)

accounts.name: Personal / Non-Deductible
accounts.description: Personal expenses, gambling, casino, luxury items, non-business withdrawals
